easyPrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Cast Mox Opal by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Opal enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mox Opal by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Mox Opal, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mox Opal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat
